evidence.title: B Corp certification
evidence.summary: Certification checked against the B Lab directory. This is not a product-level ethical judgment.

sources.name: B Lab
sources.licence: Reviewed factual certification records with links; no bulk B Lab data licence assumed.
sources.limitation: Not a complete directory; certification is not a product ethical verdict.

sources.name: Competition and Markets Authority
sources.coverage: Selected reviewed CMA cases and company associations.
sources.attribution: Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.
sources.limitation: An investigation or undertaking is not a conviction. Historical outcomes are not claims of current misconduct.

sources.name: Environment Agency
sources.licence: Unresolved: dataset page lists OGL while API metadata lists a conditional licence.
sources.limitation: Publication blocked pending confirmation of the specific dataset licence.

sources.name: Health and Safety Executive
sources.coverage: Selected reviewed HSE prosecution announcements in Great Britain.
sources.attribution: Contains public sector information published by the Health and Safety Executive and licensed under the Open Government Licence.
sources.limitation: Not a complete conviction register. Cases may include several breaches of the same incident.

sources.name: UK minimum wage naming scheme
sources.coverage: Reviewed companies in selected naming rounds, not all UK employers.
sources.attribution: Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.
sources.limitation: Publication date is not the period of underpayment. No match does not establish compliance.

sources.name: US Environmental Protection Agency
sources.coverage: Selected manually reviewed EPA enforcement announcements; no ECHO feed imported.
sources.licence: Authored factual summaries with primary-source links; no reproduction of third-party documents or images.
sources.limitation: US legal entities remain distinct from other regional companies and marketplace sellers. Historical orders do not establish current misconduct.

sources.name: World Benchmarking Alliance
sources.licence: Specific download licence must be confirmed; official pages conflict.
sources.limitation: No API credentials or approved CSV snapshot configured.

sources.name: Wikirate B Corp certification reports
sources.coverage: 2022 snapshot: 4,712 companies. One reviewed match in our registry: Tony's Chocolonely. Current import is limited to that reviewed provider ID.
sources.limitation: Historical 2022 observations, not current certification checks. A fresh API fetch does not renew the observation year. Patagonia has no answer in this metric; missing records remain unknown.
